description: This file defines a PHP trait 'FetchModeTrait' providing helper methods for statement fetching, including mapping fetch modes, converting data rows between formats, and supporting different fetch modes in Drupal's database layer.

classes.name: FetchModeTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing helper methods for statement fetch modes and data conversion in Drupal's database layer.

methods.name: assocToNum
methods.description: Converts a row from FETCH_ASSOC format to FETCH_NUM format by returning array values.

methods.name: assocToObj
methods.description: Converts a row from FETCH_ASSOC format to an object of stdClass.

methods.name: assocToClass
methods.description: Converts a row from FETCH_ASSOC format to an instance of a specified class, assigning properties from the row.

methods.name: assocToColumn
methods.description: Extracts a specific column value from a row based on column index.

methods.name: assocToFetchMode
methods.description: Converts a row in FETCH_ASSOC format to a specified fetch mode using match expression.
